name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: ReachInbox Email Scheduler - Scalable background email scheduling system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
